To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the majority of IS literature reviews are not systematic and that the quality of the literature reviews can be improved.

(a) the majority of the articles in the IS discipline are published in journals with a high impact factor, (b) the number of citations per article in the IS discipline is relatively low and does not increase over time, and (c) there are no significant differences in terms of the number of citations between articles published in journals with high or low impact factors.
